reasons.NO_FACE: We could not see a face. Please use a clear photo of your child looking toward the camera.
reasons.MULTIPLE_FACES: We can see more than one face. Please use a photo with only your child in it.
reasons.FACE_TOO_SMALL: Your child's face is too small in this photo. Please move closer or crop the photo.
reasons.LOW_CONFIDENCE: We could not see the face clearly. Please try a sharper, brighter photo.
reasons.BLURRY: This photo is blurry. Please use a sharp one.
reasons.UNDER_EXPOSED: This photo is too dark. Please use one taken in good light.
reasons.HEAD_TILTED: Your child's head is turned or tilted too much. Please use a photo facing the camera.
reasons.HEADWEAR: Please use a photo without a hat, cap or sunglasses.
reasons.DIFFERENT_CHILD: These photos do not seem to show the same child. Please make sure all three are of the same child.
reasons.UNREADABLE: We could not open this photo. Please try a JPEG or PNG.
reasons.CHECK_FAILED: Something went wrong while checking this photo. Please try again.

consent.text: I am this child’s parent or legal guardian, or I have their permission to create this book. I agree that the photos I upload will be used only to create this personalised book, processed by our cloud and AI providers on our behalf, and deleted within 30 days after delivery or sooner if I ask.
